work_experience.title: Data Analyst Intern
content: Wrote SQL with CTEs and window functions in Snowflake to build a weekly cohort retention table for 1.2 million customers.
Met with the marketing team to turn their questions about repeat purchases into a written list of metrics and definitions before building anything.
Analyzed an email A/B test with 80,000 recipients in Python, checked sample ratio mismatch, and reported a 2.1-point lift in click rate with a 95% confidence interval.
Built a Tableau dashboard for weekly revenue and retention that the marketing director used in Monday meetings.
Added dbt tests for null keys, duplicate orders and accepted values, which caught a duplicated order feed before it reached reports.
Scheduled the cohort model as a daily Airflow job and documented its inputs and owners.

work_experience.title: Student Data Assistant
content: Cleaned and merged award spreadsheets in Excel with XLOOKUP and pivot tables, reducing the monthly reconciliation from two days to half a day.
Automated the monthly report with a Python script using pandas that produced the same tables as the manual Excel process.

projects.name: Effect of Bike Lanes on Crash Rates
content: Estimated the effect of new bike lanes on crash rates in Madison with a difference-in-differences model using city crash data from 2015 to 2024.
Checked parallel pre-trends with an event-study plot and ran a placebo test on streets without new lanes.
Found a 14% drop in crashes (95% CI 4% to 23%) and wrote a two-page summary for a city council member's office.

projects.name: Spotify Listening Analysis
content: Processed 30 million rows of public listening data with PySpark on a university cluster to find weekly genre trends.
Made line and small-multiple charts in matplotlib and chose colorblind-safe palettes.

projects.name: Retail Star Schema
content: Designed a star schema with order, customer, product and date tables for a sample retail dataset, and built it with dbt models.
Wrote a data dictionary and grain statement for each table.
